questions.question: From what stage of life does the psalmist especially pray in Psalm 71?
What has the psalmist leaned on from his birth?
options: God, who took him from his mother's womb
God, who set him up securely on the throne
God, who led him safely out of Egypt
God, who gave to him the holy law
questions.answer: God, who took him from his mother's womb

questions.question: The psalmist asks God not to forsake him when his strength is spent.
